   this.rect(-33, -30, 66, 35, '#fff9e9', 14);
        c.shadowBlur = 0;
        c.strokeStyle = '#286b8d';
        c.lineWidth = 3;
        c.strokeRect(-28, -24, 56, 24);
        c.fillStyle = '#17466b';
        c.font = '900 18px system-ui';
        c.textAlign = 'center';
        c.fillText('E  TALK', 0, -7);
        c.fillStyle = '#fff9e9';
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(-6, 4);
        c.lineTo(0, 13);
        c.lineTo(6, 4);
        c.fill();
        c.restore();
    }
    drawTop(world) {
        const c = this.ctx, t = world.clock;
        this.rect(-60, -60, world.width + 120, world.height + 120, '#a5d59b', 28);
        // Long winding paths and garden beds provide directional wayfinding.
        c.strokeStyle = '#e8d9b0';
        c.lineWidth = 125;
        c.lineCap = 'round';
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(80, 465);
        c.bezierCurveTo(700, 300, 810, 870, 1370, 500);
        c.bezierCurveTo(1750, 260, 1780, 745, 2110, 490);
        c.stroke();
        c.strokeStyle = '#fff1cb';
        c.lineWidth = 7;
        c.setLineDash([8, 25]);
        c.stroke();
        c.setLineDash([]);
        for (let i = 0; i < 85; i++) {
            const x = 35 + (i * 167) % world.width, y = 25 + (i * 271) % world.height;
            if (x < 150 && y > 400 && y < 540)
                continue;
            this.ellipse(x, y, 2.5 + seed(i) * 4, 2.5 + seed(i + 4) * 4, i % 3 ? '#75b57b' : '#fff5d4');
        }
        for (const r of world.obstacles) {
            this.ellipse(r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2 + 9, r.w * .55, r.h * .47, 'rgba(38,103,76,.22)');
            this.rect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, '#679c65', 34);
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const xx = r.x + 12 + seed(i + r.x) * Math.max(1, r.w - 24), yy = r.y + 12 + seed(i + r.y) * Math.max(1, r.h - 24);
                this.ellipse(xx, yy, 23, 22, i % 2 ? '#7bc86f' : '#9ada80');
            }
        }
        for (const bar of world.movingObstacles) {
            this.rect(bar.x, bar.y, bar.w, bar.h, '#377fa1', 16);
            this.rect(bar.x + 5, bar.y + 5, bar.w - 10, 9, '#77daed', 9);
        }
        this.rect(world.gate.x, world.gate.y, world.gate.w, world.gate.h, world.gateOpen ? 'rgba(125,231,175,.23)' : '#3b81b5', 13);
        this.rect(1751, 591, 45, 46, '#ffd37b', 12);
        this.ellipse(1765, 603, 12, 12, '#bd7ab0');
        for (const r of world.ribbons)
            if (!r.got)
                this.drawRibbon(r.x, r.y, t + r.id);
        this.ellipse(world.ball.x + 4, world.ball.y + 9, 23, 9, 'rgba(36,79,56,.22)');
        this.ellipse(world.ball.x, world.ball.y, 21, 21, '#ffbe73');
        this.ellipse(world.ball.x - 6, world.ball.y - 7, 10, 6, '#ffedbe');
        this.drawTopGoal(2110, 490, t);
        this.drawTopHero(world.player.x, world.player.y, world.facingVector, t);
        if (!world.gateOpen && Math.abs(world.player.x - 1788) < 110 && Math.abs(world.player.y - 550) < 100)
            this.drawHint(1770, 495, 'E  Open gate');
    }
    drawGaps(world, t) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        const grounds = world.platforms.filter(p => p.id.startsWith('ground')).sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
        for (let i = 0; i < grounds.length - 1; i++) {
            const left = grounds[i], right = grounds[i + 1], a = left.x + left.w, b = right.x;
            if (b < this.cx - 80 || a > this.cx + this.w / this.scale + 80)
                continue;
            if (b <= a || b < this.cx - 140 || a > this.cx + this.w / this.scale + 140)
                continue;
            const mid = (a + b) * .5, top = 565, deep = top + 265;
            // A shallow ravine with rock banks and visible stream below, never a blue rectangle.
            const soil = c.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, deep);
            soil.addColorStop(0, '#586e57');
            soil.addColorStop(.24, '#405e59');
            soil.addColorStop(1, '#294f57');
            c.fillStyle = soil;
            c.fillRect(a, top, b - a, 550);
            c.save();
            c.beginPath();
            c.rect(a, top, b - a, 520);
            c.clip();
            const shimmer = c.createLinearGradient(0, top + 50, 0, top + 220);
            shimmer.addColorStop(0, '#164859');
            shimmer.addColorStop(.22, '#2b7c87');
            shimmer.addColorStop(.66, '#4db0b6');
            shimmer.addColorStop(1, '#225b73');
            c.fillStyle = shimmer;
            c.fillRect(a, top + 43, b - a, 240);
            // Pebbled rocky shores hide angular cutout and establish real edge depth.
            for (let j = 0; j < 9; j++) {
                const xx = a + (j % 2 === 0 ? 0 : b - a) + (j % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * (3 + j * 3), yy = top + 20 + j * 28;
                const rx = 10 + (j * 19) % 13, ry = 13 + (j * 11) % 10;
                this.ellipse(xx, yy, rx, ry, j % 3 ? '#706f5d' : '#8e8a6e');
                this.ellipse(xx - 3, yy - 5, rx * .62, ry * .35, '#b4a98b');
            }
            for (let k = 0; k < 13; k++) {
                const yy = top + 58 + k * 13;
                const alpha = .12 + (k % 3) * .07;
                c.strokeStyle = `rgba(222,253,247,${alpha})`;
                c.lineWidth = 1.5 + (k % 3);
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(a + 3, yy + Math.sin(t * 1.1 + k) * 2);
                c.quadraticCurveTo(mid, yy - 3 + Math.sin(t * 1.6 + k) * 3, b - 3, yy);
                c.stroke();
            }
            // Waterfall bubbles at the bottom, intentionally below the collision line.
            for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
                const xx = a + 7 + (k * 17) % (Math.max(18, b - a - 14));
                this.ellipse(xx, top + 48 + Math.sin(t * 2.2 + k) * 3, 5, 2, 'rgba(243,254,241,.60)');
            }
            c.restore();
            // Distinct grassy lips and large stone corner boulders make the gap legible.
            for (const x of [a, b]) {
                const dir = x === a ? -1 : 1;
                c.fillStyle = '#516a43';
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(x, top - 6);
                c.lineTo(x + dir * 14, top - 16);
                c.lineTo(x + dir * 5, top + 13);
                c.closePath();
                c.fill();
                this.ellipse(x + dir * 7, top + 18, 13, 14, '#7b7b63');
                this.ellipse(x + dir * 9, top + 12, 8, 4, '#b1a887');
            }
        }
    }
    drawGuideSign(x, y, title, detail) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        c.save();
        c.translate(x, y);
        const width = 106, height = 65;
        c.strokeStyle = '#5d4938';
        c.lineWidth = 8;
        c.lineCap = 'round';
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(0, -2);
        c.lineTo(0, 22);
        c.stroke();
        this.ellipse(0, 23, 24, 5, 'rgba(36,49,38,.20)');
        c.shadowColor = 'rgba(37,45,32,.28)';
        c.shadowBlur = 10;
        c.shadowOffsetY = 4;
        const fill = c.createLinearGradient(0, -64, 0, -1);
        fill.addColorStop(0, '#db9c60');
        fill.addColorStop(.48, '#a9744a');
        fill.addColorStop(1, '#76523c');
        this.rect(-width / 2, -height, width, height, fill, 12);
        c.shadowBlur = 0;
        c.shadowOffsetY = 0;
        c.strokeStyle = '#f7d7a2';
        c.lineWidth = 3;
        c.strokeRect(-width / 2 + 5, -height + 6, width - 10, height - 12);
        c.textAlign = 'center';
        c.fillStyle = '#fff6d6';
        c.font = '900 16px system-ui';
        c.fillText(title, 0, -38);
        c.fillStyle = '#f7f2e2';
        c.font = '900 12px system-ui';
        c.fillText(detail, 0, -18);
        c.fillStyle = '#ebc98a';

            for (const yy of [-55, -9])
                this.ellipse(xx, yy, 2.3, 2.3, '#f6d9a6');

    drawRibbon(x, y, t) {
        const c = this.ctx, bob = Math.sin(t * 3) * 4;
        c.save();
        c.translate(x, y + bob);
        c.rotate(Math.sin(t * 1.7) * .08);
        const halo = c.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 34);
        halo.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,241,152,.52)');
        halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,221,83,0)');
        c.fillStyle = halo;
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(0, 0, 34, 34, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        c.fill();
        c.shadowColor = '#ffc841';
        c.shadowBlur = 13;
        c.beginPath();

            const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5, r = i % 2 ? 10 : 22;

            i ? c.lineTo(xx, yy) : c.moveTo(xx, yy);

        c.closePath();
        c.fillStyle = '#f5a917';
        c.fill();
        c.lineWidth = 2.8;
        c.strokeStyle = '#fff8e2';
        c.stroke();
        c.shadowBlur = 0;
        c.save();
        c.translate(-1, -1);
        c.scale(.66, .66);
        c.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5, r = i % 2 ? 10 : 22;
            i ? c.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r) : c.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
        }
        c.closePath();
        c.fillStyle = '#ffe46c';
        c.fill();
        c.restore();
        c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.92)';
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(-6, -9, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        c.fill();
        c.restore();
    }
    drawSideHero(x, y, vx, t) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        const moving = Math.abs(vx) > 55, step = moving ? Math.sin(t * 17) * 7 : Math.sin(t * 2.6) * 1.4;
        c.save();
        c.translate(x, y + (!moving ? Math.sin(t * 2) * .5 : 0));
        this.ellipse(0, 1, 24, 6, 'rgba(26,57,62,.23)');
        // Distinct blue backpack, independent arm and foot animation.
        this.rect(-21, -42, 21, 31, '#224f84', 7);
        this.rect(-21, -36, 6, 19, '#3ca2c4', 3);
        this.line(-8, -7, -9 + step, -1, '#274c77', 8);
        this.line(6, -7, 7 - step, -1, '#274c77', 8);
        this.rect(-15, -42, 29, 34, '#278aaf', 10);
        this.rect(-9, -36, 16, 13, '#5bc3d1', 5);
        this.line(-12, -33, -20 - step * .3, -19, '#e9a979', 8);
        this.line(10, -33, 18 + step * .3, -19, '#e9a979', 8);
        this.ellipse(0, -57, 19, 20, '#f3ba86');
        this.ellipse(-17, -54, 4, 6, '#e9aa7b');
        c.fillStyle = '#6f462d';
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(-20, -63);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(-19, -92, 1, -83);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(24, -88, 19, -59);
        c.lineTo(8, -71);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(-7, -63, -20, -63);
        c.fill();
        this.ellipse(-6, -57, 3.4, 4.4, '#fffdf3');
        this.ellipse(8, -57, 3.4, 4.4, '#fffdf3');
        this.ellipse(-5, -57, 1.8, 3, '#4c322e');
        this.ellipse(9, -57, 1.8, 3, '#4c322e');
        this.line(0, -48, 8, -48, '#a65d54', 1.9);
        this.ellipse(-9, -47, 4, 2, 'rgba(234,116,117,.28)');

    }
    drawTopHero(x, y, facing, t) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        c.save();
        c.translate(x, y);
        c.rotate(Math.atan2(facing.y, facing.x) + Math.PI / 2);
        this.ellipse(0, 12, 18, 8, 'rgba(44,75,48,.18)');
        this.ellipse(0, 5, 18, 19, '#277fa4');
        this.rect(-13, -4, 26, 25, '#32a1c0', 9);
        this.ellipse(0, -13, 17, 17, '#f1bb8b');
        this.ellipse(0, -21, 16, 9, '#795139');
        this.ellipse(-7, -13, 2.2, 3, '#44302b');
        this.ellipse(6, -13, 2.2, 3, '#44302b');
        this.line(-4, -5, 5, -5, '#b1655a', 2);
        c.restore();
    }
    drawSideNpc(x, y, t) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        c.save();
        c.translate(x, y);
        this.ellipse(0, 0, 22, 5, 'rgba(31,71,54,.18)');
        this.rect(-16, -39, 31, 33, '#a684d1', 12);
        this.ellipse(0, -58 + Math.sin(t * 2.5) * 1.5, 20, 21, '#b97e59');
        this.ellipse(0, -77, 22, 10, '#51372d');
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            this.ellipse(-14 + i * 7, -77 + (i % 2) * 3, 8, 8, '#4e3226');
        this.ellipse(-6, -57, 3.5, 4, '#fff');
        this.ellipse(7, -57, 3.5, 4, '#fff');
        this.ellipse(-6, -57, 1.7, 2.5, '#302729');
        this.ellipse(7, -57, 1.7, 2.5, '#302729');
        this.line(-4, -47, 5, -47, '#713a31', 2);
        c.restore();
    }
    drawFinish(x, y, t, completed) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        this.line(x, y, x, y - 155, '#8f6d47', 7);
        this.ellipse(x, y - 150, 8, 8, '#ffca62');
        const wave = Math.sin(t * 3) * 8;
        this.rect(x, y - 146, 88, 58, completed ? '#f5c84b' : '#f4a15c', 9);
        c.fillStyle = '#fff4c5';
        c.font = 'bold 14px system-ui';
        c.fillText(completed ? 'HOORAY!' : 'BANNER', x + 12, y - 115 + wave * .08);
        this.ellipse(x - 3, y - 155, 20, 4, 'rgba(255,255,255,.5)');
    }
    drawTopGoal(x, y, t) {
        const wave = Math.sin(t * 2.5) * 5;
        this.ellipse(x, y, 56, 56, 'rgba(253,225,116,.25)');
        this.ellipse(x, y, 42 + wave, 42 + wave, 'rgba(252,206,90,.35)');
        this.ellipse(x, y, 30, 30, '#f8c65a');
        this.ellipse(x, y, 21, 21, '#fff1b9');
        this.line(x, y - 37, x, y - 100, '#675d4b', 4);
        this.rect(x, y - 105, 75, 33, '#a78ed9', 5);
    }
    drawHint(x, y, label) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        c.font = 'bold 17px system-ui';
        const w = c.measureText(label).width + 25;
        this.pill(x - w / 2, y - 26, w, 34, 'rgba(255,255,255,.96)', 17);
        c.fillStyle = '#184661';
        c.fillText(label, x - w / 2 + 12, y - 3);
    }
    /** Quiet ambient life: world-space birds and butterflies are decoration, never hidden colliders. */
    drawAmbientLife(world, quiet) {
        if (quiet || this.effectsQuiet)
            return;
        const t = this.elapsed, x0 = this.cx - 80, x1 = this.cx + this.w / this.scale + 80;
        const c = this.ctx;
        for (const [i, origin] of [210, 720, 1130, 1460, 2030, 2520, 3010].entries()) {
            if (origin < x0 - 65 || origin > x1 + 65)
                continue;
            const x = origin + Math.sin(t * .8 + i) * 23, y = 355 + Math.sin(t * 1.7 + i * .9) * 12 + (i % 2) * 85;
            const flap = Math.sin(t * 9 + i) * 5;
            c.save();
            c.translate(x, y);
            c.rotate(Math.sin(t * .5 + i) * .09);
            this.ellipse(-5, 0, 7 + flap * .2, 4.2, i % 2 ? 'rgba(224,160,205,.72)' : 'rgba(240,219,113,.76)');
            this.ellipse(5, 0, 7 + flap * .2, 4.2, 'rgba(245,250,205,.70)');
            this.ellipse(0, 1, 1.5, 5, '#68594b');
            c.restore();
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            const x = 200 + i * 357 + Math.sin(t * .34 + i * 2) * 28;
            if (x < x0 || x > x1)
                continue;
            const y = 240 + (i % 4) * 54 + Math.sin(t * .75 + i) * 13;
            c.save();
            c.translate(x, y);
            c.rotate(t * .4 + i);
            this.ellipse(0, 0, 5, 2.5, 'rgba(246,223,115,.70)');
            c.restore();
        }
    }
    drawParticles(dt, quiet) {
        const c = this.ctx;
        const step = quiet ? 0 : dt;
        for (const p of this.particles) {
            p.life -= step;
            if (p.life <= 0)
                continue;
            p.x += p.vx * step;
            p.y += p.vy * step;
            p.vy += 110 * step;
            c.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, p.life / (p.max * .55));
            this.ellipse(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size * .65, p.color);
        }
        c.globalAlpha = 1;
        this.particles = this.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
    }
    drawSoftVignette() {
        const c = this.ctx;
        const g = c.createRadialGradient(this.w / 2, this.h / 2, this.w * .2, this.w / 2, this.h / 2, this.w * .82);
        g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(12,36,42,0)');
        g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12,48,60,.10)');
        c.fillStyle = g;
        c.fillRect(0, 0, this.w, this.h);
    }
}

/* module: game/GameHost */
/** Owns only the movement lab. Approved home artwork never enters this module. */
class GameHost {
    onExit;
    onComplete;
    view = null;
    canvas = null;
    renderer = null;
    controls = new Controls();
    clock = new FixedClock(60);
    world = null;
    raf = 0;
    paused = false;
    dead = false;
    overlay = null;
    mode = 'side';
    resizeHandler = () => this.renderer?.resize();
    keyHandler = (e) => { if (this.comic?.dialogOpen) {
        if (['KeyE', 'Enter', 'Space'].includes(e.code)) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.comic.advance();
            this.actionLock = performance.now() + 330;
            this.controls.release();
            this.resumeAfterComic();
            return;
        }
        if (e.code === 'Escape' || e.code === 'KeyP') {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.comic.close(false);
            this.resumeAfterComic();
            return;
        }
        return;
    } if (e.code === 'Escape' || e.code === 'KeyP') {
        e.preventDefault();
        this.togglePause();
    } if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
        e.preventDefault();
        this.restart();
    } };
    music = new AmbientScore();
    quest = null;
    comic = null;
    actionLock = 0;
    questLabel = '';
    prefs = new PreferencesStore(undefined, defaultPreferences(typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches));
    replay = new ReplayChallengeStore();
    sfx = new Soundscape();
    stepSoundAt = 0;
    lastRunResult = '';
    introOpen = false;
    audio = null;
    muted = false;
    lastMessage = '';
    msgUntil = 0;
    pausedPainted = false;
    lastHudTime = '';
    lastHudStars = '';
    lastHudHint = '';
    constructor(onExit, onComplete) {
        this.onExit = onExit;
        this.onComplete = onComplete;
    }
    get active() { return !!this.view; }
    launch(mode) {
        this.shutdown(false);
        this.mode = mode;
        this.world = mode === 'side' ? new SideWorld() : new TopWorld();
        this.quest = mode === 'side' ? new WelcomeQuest(new QuestStore()) : null;
        if (this.quest && this.world instanceof SideWorld) {
            const checkpoint = this.quest.snapshot.checkpoint;
            if (checkpoint) {
                Object.assign(this.world.player, { x: checkpoint, y: 565, vx: 0, vy: 0 });
                Object.assign(this.world.checkpoint, { x: checkpoint, y: 565 });
                this.world.grounded = true;
            }
        }
        this.dead = false;
        this.paused = false;
        this.muted = false;
        this.music.reset();
        this.clock.reset();
        this.controls.release();
        this.controls.setAlternateJump(this.prefs.snapshot.alternateJump);
        const root = document.createElement('section');
        root.className = 'aq-play-root';
        root.dataset.mode = mode;
        root.setAttribute('aria-label', mode === 'side' ? 'Welcome Street 2D platform adventure' : 'Top-down movement lab');
        root.innerHTML = `<canvas id="aq-canvas" aria-label="Interactive 2D movement prototype" tabindex="0"></canvas>
    <div class="aq-hud" aria-live="off"><div class="aq-level-label"><span class="aq-level-tag">WORLD 1 · PREVIEW</span><strong id="aq-world-name"></strong><small id="aq-mode-desc"></small></div>
      <div class="aq-hud-right"><span class="aq-pill" id="aq-ribbons">★ 0 / 5</span><span class="aq-pill aq-time" id="aq-time">0:00</span><span class="aq-pill aq-best" id="aq-best" hidden></span><button id="aq-tutorial" class="aq-hud-button" type="button" aria-label="How to play">?</button><button id="aq-mute" class="aq-hud-button" type="button" aria-label="Toggle sound">♫</button><button id="aq-settings" class="aq-hud-button" type="button" aria-label="Game accessibility and sound settings">⚙</button><button id="aq-pause" class="aq-hud-button" type="button" aria-label="Pause">Ⅱ</button></div></div>
    <div class="aq-hint" id="aq-hint" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <div class="aq-quest-progress" id="aq-quest-progress" aria-live="polite" hidden><b>YOUR MISSION</b><span id="aq-quest-objective"></span><small id="aq-discoveries">Secrets: 0 / 2</small></div>
    <div class="aq-help"><span id="aq-control-hint"></span><span>R Restart · P Pause</span></div>
    <div class="aq-touch" aria-label="Touch game controls">
      <div class="aq-dpad"><button data-control="left" aria-label="Move left" type="button">◀</button><div class="aq-tb-middle"><button data-control="up" aria-label="Move up" type="button">▲</button><button data-control="down" aria-label="Move down" type="button">▼</button></div><button data-control="right" aria-label="Move right" type="button">▶</button></div>

            return 'Bounce over the pillar  ·  Land on the blue trampoline';
        if (x < 900)
            return 'Explore the path  ·  Find the golden stars';
        if (x < 1235)
            return 'Find Maya by the school garden';
        if (x < 1700)
            return 'Moving platform  ·  Jump when the deck comes close';
        if (x < 1880)
            return 'Second bounce  ·  Use the trampoline to clear the wall';
        if (x < 2260)
            return 'Push the ball  ·  Walk against it';

            ['music', 'Background music', 'Original Ally Quest melody, off when unchecked'],
            ['soundEffects', 'Sound effects', 'Bounce, landing, star and character cues'],
            ['largerControls', 'Larger touch buttons', 'More comfortable buttons on phones and tablets'],
            ['gentleCamera', 'Gentle camera tracking', 'Smooth look-ahead rather than immediate snapping'],

        const record = this.replay.snapshot;

        this.showCard('Welcome Street Medals', `${record.runs} completed adventures · Best time: ${best} · Best stars: ${record.maxStars}/5 · Secrets: ${record.maxSecrets}/2`, [

        if (this.overlay)
            this.overlay.hidden = true;
        this.view?.classList.remove('aq-overlay-open');
        this.flash('Fresh start! Find the banner and discover shortcuts.', 2.5);
        this.canvas?.focus();
    }
    shutdown(callExit) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
        this.controls.detach();
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        window.removeEventListener('resize', this.resizeHandler);
        this.comic?.destroy();
        this.comic = null;
        this.quest = null;
        this.questLabel = '';
        this.music.reset();
        this.view?.remove();
        this.view = null;
        this.canvas = null;
        this.renderer = null;
        this.world = null;
        this.overlay = null;
        this.dead = false;
        this.paused = false;
        this.introOpen = false;
        this.pausedPainted = false;
        this.lastHudHint = '';
        this.lastHudTime = '';
        this.lastHudStars = '';
        this.stepSoundAt = 0;
        if (this.audio) {
            void this.audio.close().catch(() => { });
            this.audio = null;
        }
        if (callExit)
            this.onExit();
    }
}
